definition: Extremely shocked and unable to respond normally for a moment.
author: Alexandre Dumas
quote: The news caused a great sensation throughout the house; Madame de Villefort would not believe it, and Valentine was thunderstruck.
example_sentence: He stood thunderstruck when his name was read out as the winner.
